neighbours.label: methods sections naming how groups were compared: the token leading into a statistical test (compared by using chi-square / log-rank / t-test)
fire: Differences in mean age between the two cohorts were compared by using a t-test.
Categorical variables were compared using Fisher's exact test.
Survival curves were estimated by the Kaplan-Meier method and compared with the log-rank test.
Group medians were compared by means of the Mann-Whitney U test.
Proportions of adverse events were compared by using chi-square tests.
The association between dose and response was assessed with a Spearman rank correlation.
Scores across the three schools were compared using one-way ANOVA.
Baseline characteristics were compared between arms with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
quiet: Differences in mean age between the two cohorts were small and are shown in Table 1.
Categorical variables are listed in the second column of the table.
Survival curves for the two groups are shown in Figure 2 of the report.
Group medians were reported alongside the full range for each item.
Proportions of adverse events were similar in the two treatment arms.
The association between dose and response is discussed in the next section.
Scores across the three schools were collected by trained volunteers.
Baseline characteristics were recorded at the first visit of each patient.
